pairs.subject: silver-medalist-rediscovery
pairs.evidence: app/features/library/jobs/jobsRediscoveryFeedLogic.ts:251 The feed's Reach out posts only id, label, archetype, score and source:'rediscovery'. No prior facts are sent, and the outreach route drafts with the generic draft_outreach ('first-contact ... inviting this candidate to apply'), so the candidate's first message never says how far they got last time.

techniques.evidence: app/features/library/jobs/jobsRediscoveryFeedLogic.ts:256 Only a source tag is sent; no role, date, stage or outcome reaches the draft. pipeline/jobfit/automation.py draft_outreach writes a cold first-contact letter.
app/features/library/jobs/JobsRediscoveryFeedRow.tsx:80 The boost is shown to the recruiter as a named, localized 'reached {stage}' reason whenever depth > 0, rather than folded into the score.

app/features/library/jobs/JobsRediscoverPanel.tsx:229 The panel shows how many eligible people the result cap dropped. Gap: jobsRediscoverySweepNote's SweepBody ignores the route's `truncated` count, so a deferred-role sweep is not disclosed in the feed.
app/features/library/jobs/jobsRediscoveryFeedLogic.ts:266 The gate's refusal is shown explicitly, with its reason, and is never shown as a send. The collapse itself is server-side.
